acceptance.given: During validator evaluation, candidate-external trust is evaluated as its own subject using the replay/validator execution path.

oracle.expected: Independent evidence records a candidate-external trust verdict derived from the candidate-external trust check itself.
forbidden: Candidate-external trust verification is omitted or inferred solely from another verification.
oracle.observable: The S24 behavior test output and captured evidence identify a distinct candidate-external trust check and its result.

acceptance.then: The validator replay completes and emits evidence for this obligation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S24 test selector must fail when candidate-external trust evidence is omitted or only inferred from another check.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add and verify an independent candidate-external trust evaluation and evidence record in the replay validator path.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result and validator schemas; rollback removes only the independent trust check wiring and its test.

slice_hint.state_transition: unverified candidate-external trust -> independently evaluated trust with attributable evidence
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S24 test passes only when a standalone candidate-external trust assertion and evidence artifact are present; omission or inference-only behavior fails.

acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subjects execute through the Matrix Case execution path.

oracle.expected: Every Matrix Case execution emits evidence naming the Matrix Case and the executed subject, with no unattributed execution result.
forbidden: Execution evidence cannot be attributed to its Matrix Case or subject.
oracle.observable: The S2 test output and evidence records contain a Matrix Case identifier and subject identity for each execution.

acceptance.then: All executed Matrix Cases have attributable evidence.
acceptance.when: When Stable and Candidate subjects execute.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S2 test selector must fail when any Matrix Case result lacks either its Matrix Case identifier or executed-subject identity.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure each Matrix Case execution constructs and persists attributable evidence linking the case and subject identities.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing evidence fields and add attribution without changing prior replay identities or result categories.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix Case execution without attribution -> execution evidence bound to Matrix Case and subject
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S2 test passes only if every produced execution record contains both required identities and can be traced back to its case; any missing link fails.

acceptance.given: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages are implemented and exercised together.

oracle.expected: Inspection and controlled execution demonstrate distinct mutable-state and evidence boundaries for every listed component, and mutating one component cannot alter another component's execution or result.
forbidden: Any listed component shares mutable state with another listed component.
Cross-component mutable-state sharing permits one component to alter another component's execution or result.
oracle.observable: The S7 structural/behavior test reports separate state or evidence containers and a cross-mutation attempt that leaves other component results unchanged.

acceptance.then: Isolation evidence is recorded for all five component classes.
acceptance.when: When these components are implemented, executed, or rolled back together.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S7 test selector must fail when component state/evidence containers alias or a cross-component mutation changes another component's result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and verify independent mutable-state and evidence containers across all five component classes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep replay interfaces stable while isolating internal mutable state; rollback must not merge or reuse component containers.

slice_hint.state_transition: shared or unproven mutable state -> independently controlled component state with contamination check
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 test passes only when all five components have non-sharing mutable-state/evidence boundaries and cross-mutation leaves peer outcomes unchanged.

acceptance.given: The Consumer Manifest contains one or more non-empty entries and applicable route transitions are executed, including rollback baseline observation.

oracle.expected: 100% of non-empty Consumer Manifest entries complete every applicable route transition and produce the required prior-behavior-baseline observation after rollback.
forbidden: A non-empty Consumer Manifest entry fails to complete an applicable route transition.
An applicable route transition is omitted for a non-empty Consumer Manifest entry.
oracle.observable: The S41 test output reconciles each non-empty manifest entry with its complete applicable transition set and shows successful completion for every pair.

acceptance.then: Every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry has completed all applicable transitions.
acceptance.when: When applicable route transitions are executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S41 test selector must fail if any non-empty Consumer Manifest entry lacks a completed applicable transition or its rollback baseline observation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Drive and verify complete applicable route-transition execution for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, including post-rollback baseline observation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve Consumer Manifest shape and route contracts; rollback restores prior behavior and does not discard transition evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: manifest entries with incomplete transitions -> complete transition matrix with rollback baseline evidence
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S41 test passes only when every non-empty entry is paired with and completes every applicable transition and the prior-behavior baseline is observed after rollback.
